correctness.rationale: The quoted source criterion reduces same-part membership to two-sided comparison of triangular defects. On e1 and e1+t e2 the exact formula expands with positive coefficient (1-2^(1-r))/r, so for p<q the defect ratio tends to zero. The endpoint r=1 has zero defect on e1,e2 while every r>1 has positive defect there; r=infinity has zero defect on e1,e1+e2 while every finite r>1 is strictly convex and has positive defect. These cases exhaust the parameter range.
